newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Valentine's Day lovers to feast on saucy spread.
newsitem.headline: Valentine's Day lovers to feast on saucy spread.

text.p: A Singapore hotel has concocted an unusual Valentine's Day love potion for those seeking to boost their sexual prowess.
The saucy spread of bull's penises and crocodile's tails is being offered for Singapore $150 (US$106) a person at the central Apollo Hotel and the 145 places are nearly all sold out.
An after-dinner port, containing the genitals of dogs, deer and seals, tops off the love birds' feast.
"The motivation is to create something which the average Singaporean has never seen before, to tickle (their) lust a little bit," said the hotel's general manager Chris Schlittler.
Schlittler, a former chef trained in Switzerland, said the dishes on offer are of "Southeast Asian flavour" and were invented by him and a team of local cooks.
The bull's penis, the main feature of the six-course menu, is cut into bite-size chunks and is cooked for six hours in the chef's special spices.
Asked if this menu would be resurrected after Valentine's Day, Schlittler said: "sure, why not, if there is good demand for it".
